tha-ap426:1.1: samattaṃ. [421. Sattakadambapupphiya.] Himavantass' avidūre Kadambo nāma pabbato / tasmiṃ pabbatapassamhi satta Buddhā vasiṃsu te. // //
tha-ap426:2.1: Kadambaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā paggahetvāna añjaliṃ / satta mālā gahetvāna puññacittena okiriṃ. // //
tha-ap426:3.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsam agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap426:4.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap426:8.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sattakadambapupphiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
